test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends S, T, U, V, W, and X sit in a row facing south. U sits exactly in between S and V. X sits exactly in between W and T. Five friends sit to the left of S. Who sits second to the left of V?
solution:
Given: Six friends S, T, U, V, W, and X sit in a row facing south.

1) Five friends sit to the left of S.

2) U sits exactly in between S and V.

3) X sits exactly in between W and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af6111adcf70569edd3e1c9c0dae038a84b8b9c94b751874cf029b302752cba5.png] 

Here, "X" sits second to the left of V.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
